name: config-lint
description: Lint and fix package.json, Docker Compose files, and Dockerfiles in the active editor.

scripts.dev: npm run start-checks && npm run build -- --watch
scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run start-checks && npm run ts && npm test && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run start-checks && esbuild scripts/test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --external:esbuild --outfile=dist/test.mjs && node dist/test.mjs
scripts.test:int:headed: npm run start-checks && npm run build && esbuild tests/integration.ts tests/run-integration.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:vscode --outdir=dist/tests --out-extension:.js=.cjs && node dist/tests/run-integration.cjs
scripts.start-checks: node helpers/start-checks.cjs && node helpers/check-package-versions.cjs && node helpers/modify-node-modules/index.cjs --check
scripts.prepare: npm run setup:dependencies && node -e "if(require('fs').existsSync('.git')) { try { require('husky').install(); } catch(e) { if(e.code !== 'MODULE_NOT_FOUND') throw e; } }"
